title: Air Fryer Grilled Peaches with Cinnamon
description: This easy air fryer grilled peaches recipe gets extra flavor from a little cinnamon. Serve it with ice cream. It's the perfect late summer dessert.
ingredients: 1 medium firm peach, halved and pitted

steps.text: Preheat an air fryer to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C) according to manufacturer's instructions.
Place peach halves flesh-sides down in air fryer basket; cook for 6 minutes.

Meanwhile, place butter in a microwave-safe bowl; microwave in 15 to 30 second intervals until melted. Stir in brown sugar and cinnamon until sugar has dissolved; microwave in 10 to 15 second intervals, if needed.
Flip peaches flesh-sides up using tongs; brush butter mixture over tops, filling pit cavities with any excess. Cook 6 minutes more.
Cool peaches for 5 minutes; top each half with 1 scoop ice cream.

video.description: Bust out the air fryer this summer for a simply delicious dessert! In this video, Natalie shows you how to make air fryer grilled peaches with cinnamon using only an air fryer and a dusting of cinnamon and sugar. The result is fried peaches that go perfectly with a scoop of ice cream to help beat the heat in style.
